project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: To automatically inherit the provider-level project ID.

service.description: The name of the service these settings apply to.
service.rationale: Names the service that these network settings apply to. This is a reference/identifier to another resource, not a security control.

network_settings.description: Ingress settings for this service. Will apply to all versions.

network_settings.ingress_traffic_allowed.description: The ingress settings for version or service. Default value: "INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_UNSPECIFIED" Possible values: ["INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_UNSPECIFIED", "INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_ALL", "INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_INTERNAL_ONLY", "INGRESS_TRAFFIC_ALLOWED_INTERNAL_AND_LB"]
network_settings.ingress_traffic_allowed.rationale: Is enforced to mitigate the risk of direct-to-origin attacks from occurring. By ensuring that the default unshielded App Engine URL is disabled.
